in_marathi.name: Chintamani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chintamani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chintamani is derived from the Sanskrit words 'chintana' (thought) and 'mani' (gem). It is believed to be a divine wish-granting gem, which bestows the holder with divine wisdom and the power to fulfill their desires.
